title: Is this an example of a mall world?

classification.question_topic: Whether the described dream environment qualifies as 'mall world' / shared parallels

meta.final_emotion: woke up in a somewhat emotional state
meta.author_theory: Dream felt like going back in time (~10–15 years ago) and showing friend was happy; described as enlightening/impactful.

qualities.raw_description: "some building that looked like a mall crossed with a school"; "many staircases and hallways, with glass windows providing plenty of illumination"; staircases/hallways "seemed to almost never end" and "would disappear into the distance, behind a wall"; hallways "vaguely unending"; "large glass covered windows everywhere, like in a mall or skyscraper foyer"; people following friend "almost like they were dancing down one of the hallways"

interactions.description: Dreamer sees an old friend (from ~10–15 years ago) moving through the building in "almost slow motion" in a "graceful" procession; she is "happy" and acknowledges the dreamer by smiling as she passes; people around her follow her lead, "almost like they were dancing" down a hallway; no words exchanged.

entities_involved.description: Friend from 10–15 years ago; moving in almost slow motion; smiling; appears happy
entities_involved.name_or_relation: a friend I used to be really close to 10–15 years ago

entities_involved.description: People around the friend following her lead; like dancing down a hallway

extraction.extraction_notes: Single primary setting described (mall/school hybrid). Strong spatial qualities (unending/disappearing corridors, many staircases, glass-lit). Time described as taking place ~10–15 years ago (dreamer identity inferred as younger self). Light temperature not explicitly stated; inferred from glass illumination.
